## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth ≤4/11 and both Financials and Industrials are negative; note Major Divergence among large caps and Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing pockets of strength: DOW (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND, APD (1W: +5.38% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Industrials lag: GE (1W: -5.57% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND, EMR (1W: -5.69% | 1M: -7.85%) BELOW TREND. Technology weak: ADBE (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND; PSX (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +11.93%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +16.19%) ABOVE TREND; APD (1W: +5.38% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY; DOW (1W: +4.93% | 1M: +11.57%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy); Style: Value/Cyclical.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: PSA (1W: -5.44% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND; GE (1W: -5.57% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND; EMR (1W: -5.69% | 1M: -7.85%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -5.78% | 1M: +11.22%) CORRECTION; ADBE (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Industrials and select high-multiple Tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +6.43% | 1M: +11.93%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +16.19%) ABOVE TREND. Watch RECOVERY pockets like LRCX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: -5.03%) RECOVERY and APD (1W: +5.38% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY as tactical momentum plays amid major-cap divergence.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is broadly weak with multiple large-cap names BELOW TREND: ADBE (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -1.89%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -1.98%) RECOVERY is a lone tactical bright spot. Sector is under pressure; watch for follow-through or deeper distribution on downgrades.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are weak: JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -5.45%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.85% | 1M: -4.34%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.78% | 1M: -3.59%) BELOW TREND. Broad Financials softness supports the RISK-OFF regime and reinforces cyclical selective positioning.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare soft overall with TMO (1W: -7.75% | 1M: -7.72%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -1.91% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND, while UNH (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.17%) ABOVE TREND is an exception. Sentiment-driven winners like NVS (+75 news) merit watch but sector momentum is weak.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to Energy and selected Materials names given narrow cyclical leadership (VLO, XOM, CVX ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to weak large-cap Tech and Industrials (ADBE, QCOM, GE BELOW TREND). Major Divergence among megacaps suggests tactical sizing and monitoring for trend breaks rather than broad redeployment.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND, APD (1W: +5.38% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -5.57% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +10.44%) showing clear leadership. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.84% | 1M: +0.64%) and Industrials (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -4.69%) as sources of downside risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) hold recent breakout to confirm continuation; XOM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +4.87%) above-trend support to validate sector leadership; ADBE (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -4.05%) failure to reclaim intermediate levels would deepen tech risk; NVDA (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -1.98%) reclaim above-weekly pivot to confirm RECOVERY.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
SO (+80): Department of Energy loan approval; price action mixed relative to sector — watch confirmation (no 1W/1M data in headlist). NVS (+75): FDA approval; aligns with bullish flows — monitor stock-specific follow-through. APD (+60): Wells Fargo upgrade; APD (1W: +5.38% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY — sentiment confirmed by 1W strength.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ADBE (-55): Analyst downgrades; ADBE (1W: -10.83% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and a material risk. QCOM (-55): downgrade on smartphone outlook; QCOM (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -5.96%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. JPM (-50): legal headlines; JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -5.45%) BELOW TREND — watch for earnings/credit flow implications.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Value/Cyclical style. XOM (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND and VLO (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +18.11%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: Major Divergence among megacaps (NVDA RECOVERY, AMZN CORRECTION/TREND EXHAUSTION, ADBE BELOW TREND) amplified by negative sentiment on select Tech and Financial names; watch for trend breaks.
